column4: Customize combat, survival, enemy spawning and loot with 18 experimental controls; your selected rules stay fixed for each run.
Choose 1–60 dungeon Scrolls of Upgrade; the normal setting remains 15.
Explore recorded runs, combat events and individual item histories in UIMSD.
Filter records, ask custom questions and compare runs without replacing your original history.
Inspect the Custom Dungeon Rules recorded for each run in details, comparisons and exports; unknown historical settings remain unknown.
Older background results no longer replace a newer statistics view or seed replay.
Statistics display fixed-point values and mixed-scale percentages in player units, and preserve lower-bound warnings for incomplete records.
See the upgrade level of each offered Blacksmith reward before choosing.
Inspect the next Chalice prick's damage and possible HP loss before deciding whether to proceed.
The Healing-to-Shielding setting affects only generated Potions of Healing; other potion and scroll conversions keep their normal behavior.
The About screen and reviewed authored dialogue use clean alternatives when Adult Humor is off.
Custom Dungeon Rules use provisional experimental scoring multipliers for new runs; original scores remain available.
Older affected first-floor saves can recover their entrance doorway without revealing unrelated secret doors.
Quickly resumed runs now use the correct finished or unfinished state when deciding what their shared history can reveal.
Exports of damaged or unreadable history retain an incomplete-data warning instead of presenting surviving statistics as complete.
Item and enemy tables retain incomplete-data warnings when a recorded event cannot be read.
The circular Imp-vault sentry uses the normal two-turn scan interval; existing affected floors retain their saved position and scan phase.
I'm bringing APD's statistics and difficulty customization together for the early-alpha preview. New runs use provisional experimental scoring multipliers, with original scores preserved separately.
